QuestInfo.name: [MapleStory X Evangelion] Rune Activation
QuestInfo.0: Dr. Kim in the Omega Sector is contacting you with an urgent request for help. You should see what he needs.
QuestInfo.1: In order for the Eva pilot to return, you need magic power. You'll have to hunt down runes in the field to free up enough power to get them safely back.
QuestInfo.2: You freed up as much magic power as you could today, but they'll definitely need more tomorrow.

default.0: We're still short on magic power. You'll have to activate more runes.
